GeneDef.label: angelic metabolism
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene draw sustenance from a divine source. It fully pays for the metabolic cost of the other angelic genes.

GeneDef.label: demonic metabolism
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are fueled by hellfire. It fully pays for the metabolic cost of the other demonic genes.

GeneDef.label: mutant metabolism
GeneDef.description: The forced evolutionary virus rebuilt this body to burn anything. It fully pays for the metabolic cost of the other super mutant genes.

GeneDef.label: ghoul metabolism
GeneDef.description: Radiation-soaked cells of this carrier need almost nothing to keep going. It fully pays for the metabolic cost of the other ghoul genes.

GeneDef.label: leviathan metabolism
GeneDef.description: A primordial hunger turns every meal into raw strength. It fully pays for the metabolic cost of the other leviathan genes.
